salon_loyalty_config_complete.name: salon_loyalty_config_complete
salon_loyalty_config_complete.value:
("salon"."loyalty_mode" = 'tiers' AND "salon"."tiers" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("salon"."loyalty_mode" = 'stamps' AND "salon"."stamp_target" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind.name: transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind
transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind.value:
("transaction"."kind" IN ('topup', 'deposit_return') AND "transaction"."amount_fils" > 0)
          OR ("transaction"."kind" IN ('charge', 'deposit_hold', 'shop') AND "transaction"."amount_fils" < 0)
          OR ("transaction"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "transaction"."amount_fils" <> 0)

idempotency_key_completed_has_response.name: idempotency_key_completed_has_response
idempotency_key_completed_has_response.value:
"idempotency_key"."status" = 'in_progress'
          OR ("idempotency_key"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_key"."response_body" IS NOT NULL
              AND "idempotency_key"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumpti.name: wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumption
wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumpti.value:
"wallet_token"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          OR ("wallet_token"."consumed_by_staff_id" IS NULL AND "wallet_token"."consumed_by_transaction_id" IS NULL)
